title: Absolute tail error from a nonuniform distribution bound
statement:
Let $
u$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb R$, and let $K,t\in\mathbb R$ with $t\ge 0$. If for every $x\in\mathbb R$ the distribution functions of $
u$ and the standard Gaussian satisfy $|F_
u(x)-\Phi(x)|\le K/(1+|x|^3)$, then their absolute tail probabilities at $t$ differ by at most $2K/(1+t^3)$.
